speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Singaporeans looking for a new job or career can tap on the Adapt and Grow initiative to supplement their own efforts.

speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Individuals also have access to a wide range of courses and initiatives under SkillsFuture to enhance or acquire new skills to stay relevant as the job market evolves.

speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
text: It is quite heartening to know that there are Singaporeans being emplaced with jobs even after they are retrenched.

speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
text: However, in conversations with residents and some volunteers, not many are aware of the whole slew of SkillsFuture initiatives and schemes available.

speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
text: Whenever we mention SkillsFuture, the first thing that comes to mind is the $500 SkillsFuture Credit.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: Actually, for SkillsFuture, the Minister is seated right here and he is better placed to answer that question.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: Indeed, if you consider the fact that SkillsFuture is a relatively new movement, the fact that so many people know of its existence is, to my mind, quite remarkable.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: Notwithstanding the fact that the one thing that is on their top of mind recall is the $500 credit.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: I think, increasingly, individuals are beginning to learn more about SkillsFuture.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: If you look at the perspective of the students, if the student is in a Polytechnic, he would know that there are programmes, such as Earn and Learn, which is one of the SkillsFuture programmes.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: Of course, at the same time, the Member correctly pointed out we would need to do things like roadshows and reach out to as many people as possible to help them understand how they can take advantage of the schemes.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: I should add that, in addition to SkillsFuture, likewise, we also conduct outreach on Adapt and Grow initiatives because, depending on individuals, whether they are actively looking for a job or they are just seeking to replenish their repertoire of skills in order to be ready for a transition in the future, I think it is worth our while to reach out to all of them.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: Many different types of approaches and channels will have to be exercised for that purpose.
